headline: Cameroon has banned pupils in nursery and primary schools from using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: only one outlet reports it and we found no second source.
importance_line: Young children and teachers in every Cameroonian school are affected, but only one outlet reports it and the article says enforcement at home rests on parents.
summary: The news site Streamlinefeed reports that Cameroon’s Ministry of Basic Education issued a directive in October 2026 banning pupils in kindergarten and primary schools nationwide from using generative AI such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot, for fear it will harm their early learning of reading, writing and arithmetic. Teachers may still use the tools to prepare lessons, but not to give pupils access in class.
notes: Single-source item; Google News search for other outlets returned only this article. Education minister Laurent Serge Etoundi Ngoa announced it on state broadcaster CRTV per the article.
